name: Veerasamy Ringadoo
role: 1st President of the Republic of Mauritius
contribution: A Mauritian politician, minister, the sixth and last governor-general of Mauritius from 1986 to 1992, and then the first president of Mauritius from March to June 1992.

checks.lead: Sir Veerasamy Ringadoo, GCMG, GCSK, QC, (20 October 1920 – 9 September 2000) was a Mauritian politician, minister, the sixth and last governor-general of Mauritius from 1986 to 1992, and then the first president of Mauritius from March to June 1992.
